question: What is the unfailing essential nature of all the principles according to the Trishiro teaching?
premises: All the principles form a single group.
Their essential nature is said to be unfailing.
The revered Trishiro teaching identifies that nature as the Self.
inference: The enduring essential nature of all principles is the Self alone.
plain_english: The unfailing essential nature of the whole group of principles is the Self alone; this is stated in the revered Trishiro teaching.
